items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: I mean how do you replace Count Basie’s All-American Rhythm Section? Hard, when you’ve been in the Basie band, or Woody Herman’s band, or whatever.

ctx.x: I’ve got a story for you on that. “My Red Robin.” That’s “My Red Robin.” That is my first solo that I played in second grade. Here’s the story, in front of the entire school my mother played like Count Basie, she was my accompanist. So I played that tune in second grade and I was nervous and I went blank on the bridge. And I ran off stage crying. And then my mother came to me and gave me a pep talk and I came back on and finished it to a standing ovation. And it goes to show you a little encouragement early on…
You know I thought about that because —
